title: Give the Page a Title
prompt:
Starting from the skeleton below, add a `title` element to the head so the browser tab reads `About Me`. The body already has content — don't change it.

Rules:
- The `head` contains a `title` element.
- The title text is exactly `About Me`.
- The body stays unchanged.
boilerplate: All about me and what I am learning.

tests.name: adds a title element
title text is exactly About Me
tests.hint: The browser tab should read 'About Me' — match the text exactly.

tests.name: title is inside the head
body paragraph unchanged
tests.hint: Only the head changes — leave the body content alone.
